description: T4-5/T9-3: the step counter is incremented once per parameter array instead of once per step (a mis-indented t += 1), so every multi-parameter model gets the wrong bias correction while a single-parameter test stays exact.

target.find:
self.t += 1
        for p, g, m, v in zip(self.params, self.grads, self.m, self.v, strict=True):
target.replace:
for p, g, m, v in zip(self.params, self.grads, self.m, self.v, strict=True):
            self.t += 1
